placeholders.{{TOKEN}}: Lucifer address (20 bytes, from the deploy receipt contractAddress)
placeholders.{{TOKEN0}}/{{TOKEN1}}: WETH and TOKEN sorted ascending by address (see ordering)
placeholders.{{AMOUNT0}}/{{AMOUNT1}}: LP_ETH / LP_TOKENS matched to token0/token1 order
placeholders.{{SQRT_PRICE_X96}}: computed at runtime from the two amounts (see ordering.js)
placeholders.{{TOKEN_ID}}: LP NFT id read from the mint receipt (see tokenId)
placeholders.note: In dataTemplate every placeholder stands for one 32-byte ABI word: left-pad the value to 64 hex chars (addresses: 24 zeros + 40 hex; negative int24 -887200 is two's complement = ffff…f27560).

ordering.rule: Uniswap sorts by address: token0 = min(TOKEN, WETH), token1 = max(TOKEN, WETH). WETH is 0x4200…0006, so TOKEN is token1 iff TOKEN > 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006 as a 160-bit integer (true for roughly 3/4 of addresses, and true for the predicted address 0xDfBd…6064).
ordering.sqrtPriceX96: sqrtPriceX96 = floor(sqrt(amount1 / amount0) * 2^96) = isqrt((amount1 << 192) / amount0), with amount0/amount1 in token0/token1 order. This is exactly LuciferLiquidity.sqrtPriceX96(amount0, amount1) in script/Liquidity.s.sol.
ordering.js: launch/liquidity-math.mjs (BigInt; run `node launch/liquidity-math.mjs <token> <lpTokens> <lpEthWei>` for a JSON of token0, token1, amount0, amount1, sqrtPriceX96)
ordering.jsInline: const sqrtPriceX96=(a0,a1)=>{const n=(a1<<192n)/a0;let x=n,y=(x+1n)>>1n;while(y<x){x=y;y=(x+n/x)>>1n;}return x;}; const tokenIsToken1=BigInt(token)>BigInt(WETH); const [t0,t1,a0,a1]=tokenIsToken1?[WETH,token,LP_ETH,LP_TOKENS]:[token,WETH,LP_TOKENS,LP_ETH];

tokenId.how: In the mint receipt, find the log with address == NonfungiblePositionManager, topics[0] == Transfer(address,address,uint256) = 0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef and topics[1] == 0x000…000 (from = zero address). tokenId = BigInt(topics[3]). Alternative: decode the IncreaseLiquidity(uint256 indexed tokenId,…) log (topic 0x3067048beee31b25b2f1681f88dac838c8bba36af25bfb2b7cf7473a5847e35f), or decode the mint return data (tokenId, liquidity, amount0, amount1) from eth_call simulation.

deadlineRule: deadline = current block timestamp + 900 s. Compute right before sending the mint tx; if the user is slow to sign, rebuild the calldata (the NPM reverts with 'Transaction too old').
slippageRule: amount0Min = amount0 * 9900 / 10000, amount1Min = amount1 * 9900 / 10000 (1% floor, integer math). Since the pool is created and initialized in the previous step at exactly this price and has no other liquidity, the mint uses ≈100% of both amounts (fork: 3,499,999.999999999999996443 LUCIFER + 0.24999999999999995 WETH; dust of 3,557 wei LUCIFER and ~50 wei WETH stays in the wallet).
preconditions: Lucifer deployed, treasury balanceOf == LP_TOKENS (3.5M liquid)
steps are sent strictly in order, each after the previous receipt has status 1

steps.label: Approve LUCIFER to the position manager
Approve WETH to the position manager
Create + initialize the 1% LUCIFER/WETH pool
steps.returns: address pool (also readable via UniswapV3Factory.getPool(TOKEN, WETH, 10000))

steps.label: Mint the full-range position to the treasury
steps.returns: (uint256 tokenId, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1); read tokenId from the Transfer log (see tokenId)

steps.label: Burn the LP NFT (send it to 0x…dEaD)
